report_title: JOMANGY: INJ3CTOR3's Self-Healing FreePBX Toll Fraud Campaign

technique_mappings.behavior: Exploit FreePBX Endpoint/filestore module to gain code execution on internet-facing PBX
technique_mappings.evidence: "Initial exploit gains code execution"; candidate CVE-2025-57819 (pre-auth SQLi) / CVE-2025-64328 (post-auth RCE)
technique_mappings.rationale: Entry is direct exploitation of a public-facing FreePBX web application.

technique_mappings.behavior: Stage-1 bash dropper and asterisk CLI commands executed on host
technique_mappings.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
technique_mappings.evidence: "Stage 1 dropper downloaded and executed"; webshell runs asterisk -rx "channel originate ..."
technique_mappings.rationale: Bash dropper + shell-invoked asterisk commands are Unix shell execution.

technique_mappings.behavior: Deploy JOMANGY and ZenharR PHP webshells to 12+ web-root paths
technique_mappings.evidence: "deploying JOMANGY - a previously undocumented PHP webshell family - alongside ZenharR"; paths under /var/www/html/
technique_mappings.rationale: PHP webshells implanted in the FreePBX web root for persistent access.

technique_mappings.behavior: Cron jobs poll C2 for k.php every 1-3 minutes; restore + watchdog cron entries
technique_mappings.evidence: "Downloads http://45.95.147.178/k.php every 1-3 minutes"; hourly + per-minute restore cron; watchdog cron for zen2/devnull2
technique_mappings.rationale: Cron is the primary re-deployment and self-heal engine.

technique_mappings.technique_name: Event Triggered Execution: Unix Shell Configuration Modification
technique_mappings.evidence: "Base64-encoded stager appended to /root/.bash_profile, /root/.bashrc"; "Executes on every root login"
technique_mappings.rationale: Shell rc-file injection executes on interactive root login.

technique_mappings.behavior: Base64 stager appended to /etc/rc.local for boot execution
technique_mappings.technique_name: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts: RC Scripts
technique_mappings.rationale: rc.local runs the stager at boot, independent of cron.

technique_mappings.behavior: Create 18 backdoor OS accounts across three privilege tiers (incl. UID-0)
technique_mappings.evidence: "18 backdoor accounts created across three privilege tiers"; UID-0: newfpbxs, newfpbx, xhimax...
technique_mappings.rationale: New local accounts, several root-equivalent, provide durable access.

technique_mappings.behavior: Modify root password and implant shared credential hashes; insert FreePBX ampusers row
technique_mappings.evidence: "Credential implantation includes root password modification"; MySQL ampusers insert (freepbxusers)
technique_mappings.rationale: Altering existing credentials + web-panel account is account manipulation.

technique_mappings.behavior: Use implanted UID-0/service accounts for continued access
technique_mappings.evidence: UID-0 accounts (admin, support, centos...) + service accounts (asterisk, freepbxuser...)
technique_mappings.rationale: Backdoor local accounts are reused as valid credentials for re-entry.

technique_mappings.behavior: Base64 + ROT13 encode payloads; dead-code blocks; base64 in cron variables
technique_mappings.technique_name: Obfuscated Files or Information: Command Obfuscation
technique_mappings.evidence: "JOMANGY uses base64 + ROT13 before eval()"; dead-code if(false){...'deadcode_anti_av'}; base64 cron vars
technique_mappings.rationale: Layered encoding + junk code hides commands from AV/analysts.

technique_mappings.behavior: Decode base64/ROT13 payload at runtime before eval()
technique_mappings.rationale: Runtime decode is the paired deobfuscation step.

technique_mappings.behavior: Block 11 competitor C2 IPs via iptables
technique_mappings.technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify System Firewall
technique_mappings.evidence: "11 competitor C2 IPs blocked via iptables"
technique_mappings.rationale: iptables rules are added to deny rivals (defensive turf control).

technique_mappings.behavior: Scrub Apache logs of 'restapps' strings with sed
technique_mappings.technique_name: Indicator Removal: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
technique_mappings.rationale: Selective log-line deletion removes exploitation evidence.

technique_mappings.behavior: Set chattr +i immutability on webshell + crontab backup copies
technique_mappings.technique_name: File and Directory Permissions Modification: Linux and Mac
technique_mappings.evidence: "8 immutable (chattr +i) backup copies"; "chattr +i flag prevents deletion even by root"
technique_mappings.rationale: Immutable attribute resists deletion, hardening persistence.

technique_mappings.behavior: Stage payloads in system-mimicking hidden dirs (/dev/shm/.systemd/, /tmp/.cache/)
technique_mappings.technique_name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location
technique_mappings.rationale: Legit-looking paths blend malicious files into the OS.

technique_mappings.behavior: HTTP(S) polling and command retrieval from C2 web paths
technique_mappings.rationale: C2 uses HTTP web requests to a static-file server.

technique_mappings.behavior: Repeatedly download k.php/wr.php payloads from C2
technique_mappings.evidence: "Re-downloads and re-executes k.php"; dual-track k.php + wr.php download
technique_mappings.rationale: Payloads are pulled from C2 onto the host on a schedule.

technique_mappings.behavior: Originate fraudulent calls over victim SIP trunks for revenue
technique_mappings.evidence: asterisk -rx "channel originate Local/<num>@<context> ..."; "victim receives carrier bill"
technique_mappings.rationale: VoIP toll fraud monetizes access at the victim's financial expense.
